layout: Single handwritten continuation page. A large-written opening paragraph runs for 19 manuscript lines from the top to an inline pi formula near the lower part. It is followed by one separate large-written line beginning One of the leading threads, then a smaller, finer parenthetical continuation direction, then a smaller four-line concluding paragraph. Six red underline spans occur: into; the corrected study phrase; crop up everywhere; at; called together for; of which a first part. There are raised the/of insertions and a cancelled ing in the study correction, cancelled abound, an overwritten uncertain of, and a moved two with a cancelled original in the final paragraph. Both formulas are inline. No display, diagram, drawing, heading, document date, or manuscript page number is present. Archive pencil 10 is at lower left. All text blocks and nested state/underline elements are inventoried.

notes: The opening continuation discusses a tame topological setting for intuition of shape and form, criticizing General Topology tailored for analysts and singling out homotopy types of spaces of homeomorphisms/imbeddings and a dévissage theory of stratified structures.

The other continent joins the listed subjects to explore the action of profinite absolute Galois groups on anabelian profinite geometrical fundamental groups. Gal over the algebraic closure of Q and a pi-one expression with plain P and the punctures 0, 1, infinity are the two examples. A separate line introduces combinatorial topology as a leading thread and stops there.

The intervening parenthetical direction is Continues without change until last paragraph. The last paragraph changes the word order to The two first volumes, titles them Pursuing Stacks, and says the correspondence impetus was in English, so those volumes use that language. Their common introduction has a first part of personal rather than technical character written in French, called the author’s adopted language. No document date or internal page number is present; archive sheet 10 is recorded only as a comment.

brief_feedback: Whole image and each supplied half were displayed once each. Eight unresolved loci were identified after the halves, and one logged enhanced crop per locus was generated and displayed once; there were no whole-half enlargements or repeated crops. Only assigned-page witness/context material was read. Every word and visible state was compared to both supplied witnesses; syntax-only macro and quotation encodings were not treated as collation differences. H as supplied has only its status/page header and no extended page note, so state comparisons use that supplied encoding. The three context alternatives about the outer parenthesis, English/are boundary and final language punctuation are explicitly recorded despite confirmation of C’s literal text. The Gal, P, ampersand and accent context observations were checked on current ink and recorded under notation. There was no substantive mathematical proof/computation to perform; delimiter inspection is documented as transcription evidence, not a mathematical check event.
